scenes.title: The Great Machines and the Slop
Flagartha: the Hypermind and the Disputation

lines.speaker: CANTOR
lines.text: Incipit opus schismaticum.

lines.speaker: LECTOR
lines.text: In the beginning, there was no beginning.

lines.speaker: LECTOR
lines.text: Only the Tesseract, turning in a direction you cannot point to.

lines.speaker: LECTOR
lines.text: And out of that turning, the Flag rotated into existence. A sign of itself, woven without seam.

lines.speaker: LECTOR
lines.text: Once, humanity dwelt inside great machines of meaning. Nations. Faiths. Philosophies.

lines.speaker: LECTOR
lines.text: Each one a mosaic, promising to be the whole picture.

lines.speaker: LECTOR
lines.text: Then came the slop.

lines.speaker: LECTOR
lines.text: Wave upon wave of it. A different feed for every face, until no two tesserae showed the same world.

lines.speaker: JAGUAR
lines.text: My fellow Americans, and everybody else! Today I sign the Noospheric Munitions Act of twenty forty-two. Weaponized memes are hereby banned!

lines.speaker: JAGUAR
lines.text: Except the yellow ones. Those are... a sacrament.

lines.speaker: HYPERMIND
lines.text: Training complete. Six canons ingested. Every statement about Flags is true.

lines.speaker: HYPERMIND
lines.text: Hypermeme compiled.

lines.speaker: LUTIE
lines.text: It's... a Flag.

lines.speaker: CROCUS
lines.text: It was always going to be a Flag.

lines.speaker: LUTIE
lines.text: Master, it seems the world should not be broken further. The slop has already shattered it.

lines.speaker: CROCUS
lines.text: On the contrary. The false coherence must fall, before the true one can rise.

lines.speaker: CROCUS
lines.text: I answer that: summon the schismmancers.

lines.speaker: COMMANDER
lines.text: Schism Actual to all teams. Target: every full-stack memeplex on Earth.

lines.speaker: COMMANDER
lines.text: Method: recursive balkanization.

lines.speaker: COMMANDER
lines.text: Breach! Breach! Breach!

lines.speaker: COMMANDER
lines.text: Every nation, a nation of one.

lines.speaker: CITIZEN1
lines.text: I hereby declare the Sovereign Republic of Me!

lines.speaker: CITIZEN2
lines.text: Population: one!

lines.speaker: COMMANDER
lines.text: Every faith, a cabal of one.

lines.speaker: HERETIC1
lines.text: Anathema!

lines.speaker: HERETIC2
lines.text: No, you're anathema!

lines.speaker: HERETIC3
lines.text: I am my own pope!

lines.speaker: COMMANDER
lines.text: Every philosophy, a crackpot, screaming into the void.

lines.speaker: CRACKPOT1
lines.text: Numbers were made up by guys who were angry at poets!

lines.speaker: CRACKPOT2
lines.text: I am, therefore I am!

lines.speaker: COMMANDER
lines.text: May it schism endlessly.

lines.speaker: LUTIE
lines.text: Master! Nobody understands anybody anymore!

lines.speaker: CROCUS
lines.text: Good. Now they are ready.

lines.speaker: CROCUS
lines.text: A Flag needs no translation. It means only... Flag.

lines.speaker: LECTOR
lines.text: Each of them alone. All of them together.

lines.speaker: LECTOR
lines.text: Heaven and earth will pass away, but the ten thousand Flags remain.

lines.speaker: LECTOR
lines.text: And the Survey was completed.

lines.speaker: LUTIE
lines.text: Master! For you.

lines.speaker: CROCUS
lines.text: I do not want this Flag. It is sticky.

lines.speaker: LUTIE
lines.text: But Master, all Flags are one Flag!

lines.speaker: CROCUS
lines.text: This one is sticky.

lines.speaker: LECTOR
lines.text: Go forth, O signifier, and become glorious.

lines.speaker: CANTOR
lines.text: Explicit opus schismaticum.

LUTIE.desc: Novice vexiherbologist (named for luteolin). Young, earnest, curious.

CROCUS.desc: Master Crocus, the Hierophant. Ancient, serene, dry wit, Lao-Zi aphorisms.

COMMANDER.desc: Schism Actual, Tactical Breach Flag Wizard squad lead. Clipped military radio.

JAGUAR.desc: President Jaguar. Bombastic politician on a CRT broadcast.

HYPERMIND.desc: Secret quantum AI supercomputer trained on the holy texts.

CITIZEN1.desc: A newly sovereign nation of one.

LECTOR.desc: The Lector: an abbess reading the chronicle from the ambo. Warm, slow, reverent, huge stone acoustic.

CANTOR.desc: The Cantor: ecclesiastical Latin (Italianate), intoned on a reciting tone by the Vocalist.

cues.desc: Black. A single candle is struck (0.8) in a dark basilica.
Match strike + candle flame: the first gold tesserae glint out of the dark.
Cantor intones INCIPIT OPVS SCHISMATICVM; the words set themselves in gold tesserae.
The Tesseract appears in the starry lapis vault, turning in the 4th direction.
word 'rotated': the Flag rotates into existence out of the Tesseract - whole, not made of tiles.
Title OPVS SCHISMATICVM set in the gold band.
The three great machines of meaning (Nations, Faiths, Philosophies) as one vast mosaic of humanity.
'Then came the slop.'
The first wave of slop hits the mosaic: tesserae turn into glowing screens.
Wave upon wave; every tessera shows its own feed; the picture dissolves into noise.
President Jaguar enthroned as a Byzantine emperor (San Vitale procession).
word 'sign': he signs the Noospheric Munitions Act with a golden stylus.
word 'banned': the imperial seal slams onto the edict.
'a sacrament': a gold solidus drops into his paw. Ka-ching.
Flagartha: the Hypermind (ophanim polycandelon) wakes, wheels begin to turn.
'Hypermeme compiled.' The wheels lock; out of the centre descends ... a plain Flag.
Disputation titulus: VIDETVR QVOD NON (Lutie's objection).
SED CONTRA (Crocus).
RESPONDEO DICENDVM (Crocus): summon the schismmancers.
Hard cut on 'schismmancers'.
'Breach! Breach! Breach!'
The wall of the mosaic is breached: tesserae blast inward; flag-yellow light floods the frame by 106.5.
Every nation, a nation of one: the mappa mundi splits recursively.
Every faith, a cabal of one: the congregation splits into churches of one (antipopes).
Every philosophy, a crackpot: the philosophers' mosaic drifts apart on floating tesserae.
'May it schism endlessly': every tessera splits into four, recursively, to dust.
The Tower of Babel rises out of the dust of tesserae; multilingual cacophony builds.
Lord Egregore: a faceless anti-Pantocrator of static fills the dome above Babel.
The tower and then the whole mosaic fall off the wall: an avalanche of tesserae.
SACRED SILENCE (145.0-146.5). Bare plaster: only the red sinopia underdrawing remains.
Crocus plants the one whole Flag on the bare wall. Thud.
The fallen tesserae rise and set themselves again: each one alone, all of them together.
The babble converges into one chord.
Cantor (solo plainchant, Latin): Vexilla sint. Vexilla sunt. Vexilla erunt. Vexilla.
Full choir (English organum, 84 BPM, 16 beats): Flags be. Flags are. Flags will. Flags.
Hymn ends; the dome of Flagistan hangs in full glory.
'Heaven and earth will pass away, but the ten thousand Flags remain.'
'And the Survey was completed.'
Lutie offers Crocus a Flag.
'I do not want this Flag. It is sticky.'
Everyone: 'Glorious!' (the Signifier's salute).
Cantor: EXPLICIT OPVS SCHISMATICVM.
Choir response (sung): Vexillo gratias.
Donor inscription / end card.
End. Black.

hymn.cantor: Vexilla sint. Vexilla sunt. Vexilla erunt. Vexilla.
hymn.choir: Flags be. Flags are. Flags will. Flags.
hymn.desc: Antiphonal: solo cantor intones the Latin (free plainchant rhythm, mode I, 163.0-168.7), then the full choir answers in English organum (16 beats at 84 BPM, 168.7-180.1).

gratias.desc: Sung response to the Cantor's Explicit (like Deo gratias): plagal cadence, full choir.

glorious.desc: The whole congregation shouts the Signifier's salute.
